	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_maritime_silk_road.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
		OR = { # [v70_mchain]
			has_variable = oe_v70_mch_v50_romp_c03_s2
			current_year >= 1360
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_romp.511.a
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_romp.511.a.tt
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v50_romp_mod_ev_poseidon_convoy years = 15 mode = replace }
		add_navy_tradition = navy_tradition_mild_bonus
		hidden_effect = {
			# [v70_mchain]
			set_variable = { name = oe_v70_mch_v50_romp_c03_s3 value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_romp.512 days = { 365 730 } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_romp.511.b
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_romp.511.b.tt
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v50_romp_mod_oracle_hermes years = 10 mode = replace }
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		hidden_effect = {
			# [v70_mchain]
			set_variable = { name = oe_v70_mch_v50_romp_c03_s3 value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_romp.512 days = { 365 730 } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_romp.511.c
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_romp.511.c.tt
		add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus }

oe_romp.521 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_romp.521.title
	desc = oe_romp.521.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v230_spqr_roman_senate_revival.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_romp.521.a
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_romp.521.a.tt
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v50_romp_mod_ludi_civic years = 15 mode = replace }

		add_religious_influence = religious_influence_mild_bonus

		add_army_tradition = army_tradition_mild_bonus
